comment: The International Patient Summary is described as defining the meaningful minimum for “a given exchange.” IPS defines a particular patient-summary use case, not a generic minimum for all health exchanges.

public.text: The International Patient Summary is described as defining the meaningful minimum for “a given exchange.” IPS defines a particular patient-summary use case, not a generic minimum for all health exchanges.
